description: NaCNO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to two equivalent N and three O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaN₂O₃ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.46 Å) and one longer (2.52 Å) Na-N bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.47 Å. C is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one N and two O atoms. The C-N bond length is 1.30 Å. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.36 Å) C-O bond length. N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one C, and one O atom. The N-O bond length is 1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one C, and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom.
